questions.q: All visitors must sign in at the front desk ______ entering the building.
questions.exp: 「建物に入る前に」。before は前置詞・接続詞で、entering は動名詞。during は期間を表す名詞が続く。among は「〜の間で」、unless は接続詞で、意味が合わない。

questions.q: The new manager is known for her ______ approach to solving problems.
questions.exp: 名詞 approach を修飾するので、形容詞 creative が入る。creatively は副詞、creation は名詞、create は動詞。

questions.q: Ms. Park ______ the sales report to the board by the end of the day.
questions.exp: by the end of the day「その日の終わりまでに」は未来の期限なので will submit。has submitted や submitted は、未来の期限と合わない。submitting は動詞の形として不完全。

questions.q: The conference room is ______ to hold more than one hundred people.
questions.exp: 形容詞を修飾する enough は、形容詞の後ろに置く(large enough to ~)。「〜するのに十分な広さ」。

questions.q: Employees who wish to take vacation ______ the holiday season must notify their supervisors in advance.
questions.exp: over the holiday season「休暇シーズンの間」。over は期間を表す前置詞としても使える。onto は「〜の上へ」で意味が合わない。

questions.q: The project was completed ______ budget thanks to the team's careful planning.
questions.exp: under budget「予算内で」は決まった表現。

questions.q: Please ______ the attached form and return it to the personnel office by Friday.
questions.exp: Please で始まる命令文なので、動詞の原形 complete が入る。

questions.q: ______ the heavy snow, all flights to Chicago were canceled this morning.
questions.exp: 後ろが名詞句(the heavy snow)なので、前置詞の Due to「〜のために」。Although・Because・In case は接続詞で、後ろに文が必要。

questions.q: The marketing director asked the team to review the proposal ______ before the presentation.
questions.exp: 動詞 review を修飾するので、副詞 carefully が入る。

questions.q: Mr. Tanaka, ______ office is on the third floor, will join us for lunch.
questions.exp: 空所の後ろに名詞 office があり、「その人の事務所」という所有の関係なので、関係代名詞の whose が入る。
